source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.leaves: Usually linear-lanceolate to lanceolate, sometimes oblanceolate, narrowly ovate or narrowly obovate, 5–12(–16) cm long × 1–2.5(–4) cm wide
morphology_documented.habitat: Moist forests; flora's region largely northeastern Texas Red River drainage
